points.K1: 微生物燃料电池：细菌分解废物
points.K2: 电子流向电极：解毒又发电

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，身旁一个小灯泡连着一个装泥水的容器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench beside a small light bulb wired to a container of muddy water, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 细菌不光能吃废物，还能发电。
overlay: 菌群接力：边解毒，边发电

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指向两个图标：电池、一群手拉手的细菌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to two floating icons: a battery and a group of bacteria holding hands.
shots.narration: 今天讲燃料电池和混合菌群。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研从污水厂带回一桶密封的污泥样
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries a sealed bucket of sludge sample with a blank label into the lab.
shots.narration: 小研从污水厂带回一桶污泥。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰好奇地凑过来，看着密封的污泥桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans over curiously to look at the sealed sludge bucket.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：这黑乎乎的，能干什么？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研笑着指向桌上连着小灯泡的容器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and points to a container on the bench wired to a small light bulb.
shots.narration: 小研说：里面的细菌，能发电！

shots.section_title: 微生物燃料电池：细菌分解废物
shots.scene: 一个两格的容器，左格装泥水，右格清水，中间一层膜
shots.prompt_en: A two-chamber container: muddy water on the left, clear water on the right, a thin membrane between them. No people.
shots.narration: 这是微生物燃料电池。
overlay: 微生物燃料电池：细菌分解废物

shots.section_title: 微生物燃料电池：细菌分解废物
shots.scene: 左格里细菌聚在一根黑色电极上，吃掉周围的污物颗粒
shots.prompt_en: In the left chamber, bacteria cluster on a black electrode rod and consume the dirt particles around them. No people.
shots.narration: 里面的电活性细菌，分解有机或有毒废物。

shots.section_title: 微生物燃料电池：细菌分解废物
shots.scene: 两个废物图标：一袋有机废物、一桶带骷髅象形图的有毒废物
shots.prompt_en: Two waste icons: a bag of organic waste and a drum of toxic waste with a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 有机废物、有毒废物，它都能处理。

shots.section_title: 电子流向电极：解毒又发电
shots.scene: 细菌身上冒出小火花，沿着电极流出去
shots.prompt_en: Small sparks pop out of the bacteria and flow along the electrode rod. No people.
shots.narration: 分解时放出的电子，流向电极，
overlay: 电子流向电极：解毒又发电

shots.section_title: 电子流向电极：解毒又发电
shots.scene: 导线把两格连起来，中间的小灯泡亮了
shots.prompt_en: A wire connects the two chambers and a small light bulb in the middle lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 形成电流，小灯泡就亮了。

shots.section_title: 电子流向电极：解毒又发电
shots.scene: 左格的泥水逐渐变清，灯泡一直亮着
shots.prompt_en: The muddy water in the left chamber slowly turns clearer while the bulb stays lit. No people.
shots.narration: 废物解了毒，还顺便发了电。

shots.section_title: 混合菌群：代谢互补，强过单菌
shots.scene: 一个细菌独自面对一大块复杂的污染物，满头大汗
shots.prompt_en: A single bacterium faces a huge tangled pollutant block alone, looking tired. No people.
shots.narration: 单一菌株，本事有限。
overlay: 混合菌群：代谢互补，强过单菌

shots.section_title: 混合菌群：代谢互补，强过单菌
shots.scene: 几种不同形状的细菌围成一圈，手拉手
shots.prompt_en: Several bacteria of different shapes form a circle, holding hands. No people.
shots.narration: 混合菌群，把不同的本事组合起来，

shots.section_title: 混合菌群：代谢互补，强过单菌
shots.scene: 拼图块拼在一起，每块一种细菌
shots.prompt_en: Puzzle pieces fit together, each piece showing a different bacterium. No people.
shots.narration: 代谢互补，解毒效果更好。

shots.section_title: 接力降解：先拆大分子，再收尾
shots.scene: 一个细菌把大块污染物切成几段
shots.prompt_en: One bacterium cuts a big tangled pollutant block into several smaller pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 一种菌先上，拆开复杂的污染物，
overlay: 接力降解：先拆大分子，再收尾

shots.section_title: 接力降解：先拆大分子，再收尾
shots.scene: 另一群细菌接过小段，继续分解
shots.prompt_en: Another group of bacteria takes the smaller pieces and keeps breaking them down, like a relay race. No people.
shots.narration: 其他菌接棒，继续往下分解，

shots.section_title: 接力降解：先拆大分子，再收尾
shots.scene: 最后剩下水滴和小气泡，旁边绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: At the end only water drops and small bubbles remain, with a green check mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 直到变成无害的产物。

shots.section_title: 例子：清理油污，好氧厌氧都要
shots.scene: 海面上一片黑色油污
shots.prompt_en: A dark oil slick spreading on the sea surface. No people.
shots.narration: 比如海上的油污。
overlay: 例子：清理油污，好氧厌氧都要

shots.section_title: 例子：清理油污，好氧厌氧都要
shots.scene: 水面上的细菌旁有氧气泡，水底泥里的细菌没有
shots.prompt_en: Bacteria near the water surface surrounded by oxygen bubbles, and other bacteria in the mud below without bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 要清干净，需要好氧菌和厌氧菌，

shots.section_title: 例子：清理油污，好氧厌氧都要
shots.scene: 上下两群细菌一起，油污慢慢消失
shots.prompt_en: The two groups of bacteria work together and the oil slick slowly disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 上下配合，共同完成。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在电池和手拉手细菌两个图标前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a battery icon and a group of bacteria holding hands.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 细菌、电极、亮着的灯泡
shots.prompt_en: Bacteria on an electrode with a lit light bulb above. No people.
shots.narration: 燃料电池：细菌分解废物，电子发电。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 接力的细菌和消失的油污
shots.prompt_en: Bacteria passing pieces in a relay, and an oil slick fading away. No people.
shots.narration: 混合菌群接力降解，好氧厌氧配合。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 细菌也讲团队合作，下次见！
